title: 💡 Bounty Platform for Prometheus
body:
Hi Prometheus team! 👋

I wanted to share **Roxonn** - a decentralized bounty platform to help accelerate development.

**What is Roxonn?**
✅ Fund GitHub issues with crypto bounties (XDC, USDC, ROXN)
✅ Notify 300+ developers
✅ Auto-pay when PRs merge
✅ Zero crypto setup needed

**Flow:**
1. Register repo (GitHub App)
2. Fund pool with USDC
3. Assign bounties
4. PR → payment automatic

**Benefits:**
- Developer network
- **0.5% platform fee**
- Transparent blockchain

Learn: **https://roxonn.com**

*Sharing a resource!*
